title: Alert / Incident v1.3
description: Frozen alert contract. THIS FILE is the source of truth for required fields, types, enum values, evidence structure, observability state, detector metadata, incident identity and chain fields - not any prose document. Contract tests fail on schema drift. Source: FINAL_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN_V6.3.md sections 6.3, 6.3.1, 7B, 13, 19.1.

timestamp.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field. Required ISO-8601 display/alert time.

observed_time.description: Original observation time, preserved separately from the replay-rebased display time.

flow_id.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field. NEVER NULL. sha256(canonical_value).hexdigest()[:16] - exactly 16 lowercase hex chars, a 64-bit truncated SHA-256, NOT 16 bytes (Phase 0 decision DOC-006). For a spoofed flood there is no honest single source flow, so flow_ref_type is 'aggregate' and the canonical dedup identity is hashed.

flow_ref_type.description: flow_5tuple - one concrete flow is observable. aggregate - DDoS/reflection or another multi-flow event. entity - DGA, scan or similar behaviour best represented by a source/entity identity.

contributing_flow_ids.description: Optional bounded SAMPLE of underlying flows. Evidence only - never replaces the mandatory flow_id.

ps_class.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field. The six PS26145 classes, frozen external wording, verbatim. External material uses these strings only.

threat_class.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field. The concrete internal detector label. Remains internal terminology.

detector.description: The eight internal detector modules. Six classes, eight modules - a contract test asserts every detector maps to exactly one ps_class. Slowloris is a path inside 'ddos', not a ninth module.

confidence.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field - the property is always present. May be null for statistical detectors, where the UI labels the output a risk/anomaly score. Semantics are governed by score_type and calibrated.

score.description: Raw detector score, kept separate from the PS-required confidence field.

score_type.description: robust_z and rule_score are NEVER probabilities. Only model_probability may be calibrated.

calibrated.description: The UI appends a percent sign ONLY when this is true. A robust z-score or rule score is never presented as a probability.

evidence.description: PS constraint-(e) mandatory field. Actual observed feature values and their interpretation. Each detector must satisfy its minimum-evidence contract (design.md section 12).

qtype_distribution.description: DNS tunnel: TXT/NULL/CNAME and other shares. A PS-named discriminator - must be exposed in the evidence drawer.

reserved_source_share.description: Reflection. Computed against EXTERNAL address space only, with declared lab prefixes excluded from the bogon set. The exclusion is stated in the drawer text.

baseline.description: What the observation was compared against.

threshold.description: The detector threshold in force, from config/thresholds.yaml.

incident_id.description: sha256(canonical(dedup_key)).hexdigest()[:16]. Stable across restarts. Same 16-hex-character form as flow_id.

dedup_key.description: Canonical serialized deduplication key. Unavailable components carry the exact sentinel string NOT_OBSERVABLE - never null, empty string, zero or 'unknown' (Phase 0 decision DOC-007).

capability.description: Evidence-visibility axis. Missing evidence is NEVER converted into a benign result; the alert records the visibility limitation.

missing_evidence.description: Named evidence fields that were not observable for this alert.

suricata_version.description: Pinned 7.0.3 or later for JA4. Recorded in every alert.

model_version.description: For the DGA rule fallback this is 'rules-fallback' with calibrated=false. No Brier score or reliability diagram is published for the fallback.

latency_ms.description: t_observed to t_websocket_emit. MEASURED, never estimated. SLO p95 below 2000 ms.

recommendation.description: ADVISORY TEXT ONLY. There is no mitigation button, command, API call or return path anywhere in the system.

seq.description: Monotonic across the whole store, not per incident.

prev_hash.description: FULL 64-character SHA-256 digest - never truncated. Genesis is 64 zeros. The 16-char truncation applies only to flow_id and incident_id.

entry_hash.description: sha256(prev_hash || seq || incident_id || last_updated || payload_hash). Concatenation defined ONCE in alerts/hash_chain.py and imported by the verifier.

payload_hash.description: sha256(canonical(incident_payload)). Canonical form: JSON, keys sorted, no whitespace, UTF-8, NaN/Inf rejected.
